source_item: ASGI server request admission and draining around the lifespan protocol
exclusion_reason: The request-admission gate and server-wide draining of active connections are ASGI-server responsibilities: Starlette.__call__ dispatches each supplied scope, and Router.lifespan only exchanges startup/shutdown protocol messages; neither tracks startup readiness or active connections. Response awaits an attached BackgroundTask before its ASGI call returns, and TestClient waits for startup before its managed context returns, but those independent Starlette behaviors are already mapped by asgi-core.background.* and asgi-core.docs.testclient-lifespan-context. An input that asserted server admission/draining would compare behavior imposed by the test server, not an independent Starlette runtime contract.

observation_selectors: action_results[*].action_id; action_results[*].outcome; action_results[*].error_message; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Offer protocols and accept with a selected protocol plus optional response headers.
observation_selectors: websocket.accept_subprotocol; websocket.accept_headers; asgi_event_order

stimulus_summary: Accept and close with a chosen code and reason; observe the peer disconnect.
observation_selectors: websocket.disconnect_code; websocket.disconnect_reason; exception_type_and_observable_payload

stimulus_summary: Receive a connection and close before acceptance.
observation_selectors: websocket.connection_outcome; websocket.denial_status; websocket.close_code

stimulus_summary: Expose the denial-response extension in scope, receive connect, and submit a response through WebSocket denial handling.
observation_selectors: websocket.denial_status; websocket.denial_headers; websocket.denial_body; asgi_event_order

stimulus_summary: Supply repeated lowercase ASGI header names; compare items, dictionary projection, case-varied lookup, getlist order, and rejected item assignment.
observation_selectors: header.items; header.mapping; header.lookup; header.getlist; header.length; header.assignment-error

stimulus_summary: Check offered subprotocols and raise an HTTP exception before acceptance for the unauthorized branch; accept the authorized branch.
observation_selectors: websocket.connection_outcome; websocket.denial_status; websocket.accept_subprotocol; websocket.messages

stimulus_summary: Accept TestClient WebSocket sessions for text, bytes, and JSON; iterate each supplied client frame and return an app-selected response, then close each session to deliver disconnect and end async iteration.
observation_selectors: websocket.receive; websocket.send; websocket.disconnect; session.actions; app.completed; event_tape

stimulus_summary: Send and receive JSON in text frames by default and binary frames with the mode argument.
observation_selectors: websocket.messages; websocket.frame_type; response_json_value

stimulus_summary: Route a WebSocket path with a named parameter and inspect path_params in the endpoint.
observation_selectors: websocket.path_params

stimulus_summary: Supply an inline query URL, construct WebSocket in the app, and return the parsed query_params mapping.
observation_selectors: websocket.query_params; client.receive_json.params

source_item: generic message methods and state tracking
stimulus_summary: Exchange generic ASGI WebSocket messages with valid and invalid state transitions.
observation_selectors: asgi_event_order; websocket.client_state; websocket.application_state; exception_type_and_observable_payload

stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocket from an input ASGI scope; read its input-selected type key, convert it to dict, then compare key order and length.
observation_selectors: scope-mapping.keyed_value; scope-mapping.mapping; scope-mapping.iteration_order; scope-mapping.length

stimulus_summary: Accept and send/receive text and binary frames using typed helper methods.
observation_selectors: websocket.messages; websocket.close_code

stimulus_summary: Supply a relative URL and an explicit-port URL with query text; construct WebSocket from each live TestClient scope and send str(websocket.url), path, port, and scheme to the client.
observation_selectors: websocket.url; websocket.url.path; websocket.url.port; websocket.url.scheme; client receive_json values

stimulus_summary: Construct two WebSocket objects from separate copies of the same supplied scope; observe self and distinct-instance equality plus set membership.
observation_selectors: scope-mapping.identity.self_equal; scope-mapping.identity.distinct_equal; scope-mapping.identity.distinct_not_equal; scope-mapping.identity.self_in_set; scope-mapping.identity.peer_in_self_set; scope-mapping.identity.self_set_equals_recreated_self_set

stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocket from {'type': 'websocket', 'path': '/abc/', 'headers': []}; observe keyed type lookup, mapping conversion, ordered keys, and length.
observation_selectors: scope-mapping.keyed_value; scope-mapping.mapping; scope-mapping.iteration_order; scope-mapping.length

stimulus_summary: Call TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an input ASGI app that accepts with one ordered header pair; compare the session's extra_headers with the live websocket.accept headers.
observation_selectors: WebSocketTestSession.extra_headers; ordered websocket.accept headers; event order

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an app that accepts then closes with code 1001; call receive_text and capture the resulting WebSocketDisconnect.
observation_selectors: projected scope; websocket.close and websocket.disconnect events; WebSocketDisconnect class/code/reason; app completion; portal thread state after exit

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an app that accepts, awaits WebSocket.receive_text(), and captures WebSocketDisconnect while the client closes with code=1001 and reason='Going Away'.
observation_selectors: raw websocket.disconnect event; WebSocketDisconnect class/code/reason

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket, accept the supplied connect event, then call send_text('Hello, world!') while the ASGI send callback raises OSError with the supplied message.
observation_selectors: WebSocketDisconnect class/code/reason/context; ordered ASGI callback tape; final client_state and application_state

stimulus_summary: Connect, accept, call WebSocket.close twice, and record the live outcomes and ASGI callback tape.
observation_selectors: first close ASGI event; second close action error class/message; callback order; final client/application states

stimulus_summary: Call TestClient.websocket_connect('/') on both supported backends with an app that accepts and receives twice; close the input client session and observe the application exception raised during context teardown.
observation_selectors: projected scope; websocket event tape; application exception class/message; app completion; portal thread state after exit

stimulus_summary: Call TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an input ASGI app that accepts without additional headers; compare the session's empty extra_headers with the live websocket.accept headers.
observation_selectors: WebSocketTestSession.extra_headers; empty websocket.accept headers; event order

stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocket from the supplied scope and callbacks; provide websocket.connect then websocket.receive, call accept(), assign client_state=CONNECTING, and call receive().
observation_selectors: action_results; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket in the connecting application state with a supplied websocket.connect event, then call receive_bytes before accept.
observation_selectors: action error class/message; ordered ASGI callback tape; final client_state and application_state

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket in the connecting application state with a supplied websocket.connect event, then call receive_json with its default valid mode before accept.
observation_selectors: action error class/message; ordered ASGI callback tape; final client_state and application_state

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket, accept the supplied websocket.connect event, then call receive_json(mode='invalid').
observation_selectors: action error class/message; ASGI callback tape with no receive after accept; final WebSocket states

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket in the connecting application state with a supplied websocket.connect event, then call receive_text before accept.
observation_selectors: action error class/message; ordered ASGI callback tape; final client_state and application_state

stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocket with two supplied websocket.connect events; receive the first, send websocket.accept, then receive the second while connected.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].outcome; action_results[*].error_class; action_results[*].error_message; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an ASGI app that receives through WebSocket.receive() and calls WebSocket.close() with the input close code before accepting.
observation_selectors: projected scope; propagated WebSocketDisconnect class/code/default reason; app completion; portal thread state after exit

stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocket and call send with an input websocket.send message while the application state is connecting.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].action_id; action_results[*].outcome; action_results[*].error_message; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Receive the input websocket.connect event, then pass the input-defined status/content/headers Response to WebSocket.send_denial_response.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; asgi_callback_tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Receive the input websocket.connect event, create FileResponse from the supplied filename/content/modification time, then pass it to WebSocket.send_denial_response.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; asgi_callback_tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Receive the input websocket.connect event, create StreamingResponse from the supplied body chunks, then pass it to WebSocket.send_denial_response.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; asgi_callback_tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket, accept the supplied websocket.connect event, then call send_json({}, mode='invalid').
observation_selectors: action error class/message; ASGI callback tape with no send after accept; final WebSocket states

stimulus_summary: Construct the app, route, or WebSocket scope for this behavior family and supply these request/event inputs in order: websocket_connect('/').
observation_selectors: websocket.messages; websocket.close_code; websocket.denial_status; websocket.denial_headers; websocket.denial_body; exception_type_and_observable_payload

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an ASGI app that receives websocket.connect, sends websocket.http.response.start with status 404 plus content-type=text/plain and foo=bar headers, then sends the hard body chunk with more_body=True and the terminal body chunk.
observation_selectors: ASGI receive and send event tapes; WebSocketDenialResponse class; WebSocketDisconnect isinstance result; httpx.Response isinstance result; status_code; ordered response headers; concatenated content bytes

stimulus_summary: Construct the app, route, or WebSocket scope for this behavior family and supply these request/event inputs in order: websocket_connect('/').
observation_selectors: websocket.messages; websocket.close_code; websocket.url; websocket.denial_status; websocket.denial_headers; websocket.denial_body; exception_type_and_observable_payload

stimulus_summary: Construct WebSocket and send websocket.accept twice so the second send is attempted in the connected application state.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].outcome; action_results[*].error_class; action_results[*].error_message; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/', subprotocols=['soap', 'wamp']) against an ASGI app that accepts the selected 'wamp' subprotocol and closes.
observation_selectors: scope.subprotocols; websocket.accept.subprotocol; session.accepted_subprotocol; session.actions; event_tape

stimulus_summary: Accept the supplied WebSocket connect event, decode one binary JSON frame, send the same JSON value as a binary frame, and close.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; ordered ASGI callback tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/') against an app that accepts then closes with code 1001 and reason 'Going Away'; call receive_text and capture the resulting WebSocketDisconnect.
observation_selectors: projected scope; websocket.close and websocket.disconnect events; WebSocketDisconnect class/code/reason; app completion; portal thread state after exit

stimulus_summary: Construct the app, route, or WebSocket scope for this behavior family and supply these request/event inputs in order: websocket_connect('/'), send_json({'hello': 'world'}).
observation_selectors: websocket.messages; websocket.close_code

stimulus_summary: Accept the supplied WebSocket connect event, decode one Unicode JSON text frame, send the same JSON value as a text frame, and close.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; ordered ASGI callback tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Use TestClient.websocket_connect('/123?a=abc') against an ASGI3 app that raises the input AssertionError before sending a handshake; compare both supported backend configurations.
observation_selectors: projected scope; propagated exception class/message/stage; app completion; portal thread state after exit

stimulus_summary: Construct the app, route, or WebSocket scope for this behavior family and supply these request/event inputs in order: websocket_connect('/'). Record whether brotli or brotlicffi is loaded because the upstream test is conditionally skipped when either is present.
observation_selectors: websocket.messages; websocket.close_code; websocket.accept_headers

stimulus_summary: Accept a TestClient WebSocket, iterate binary input with iter_bytes(), and send the input-defined byte prefix for each yielded item; client sends b'Hello, world!' and receives the response, then session exit delivers disconnect.
observation_selectors: websocket.receive; websocket.send; session.actions; app.completed; event_tape

stimulus_summary: Accept a TestClient WebSocket, iterate JSON input with iter_json(), and send each yielded value under the input-selected object key; client sends {'hello': 'world'} and receives the response, then session exit delivers disconnect.
observation_selectors: websocket.receive; websocket.send; session.actions; app.completed; event_tape

stimulus_summary: Accept a TestClient WebSocket, iterate text input with iter_text(), and send the input-defined prefix for each yielded item; client sends 'Hello, world!' and receives the response, then session exit delivers disconnect.
observation_selectors: websocket.receive; websocket.send; session.actions; app.completed; event_tape

stimulus_summary: Connect to ws://example.com:123/123?a=abc; construct WebSocket from its live scope, send the URL and selected components, then close.
observation_selectors: app websocket.url.port; emitted websocket.send JSON; client receive_json value

stimulus_summary: Construct a WebSocket in the ASGI app for websocket_connect('/?a=abc&b=456'), cast query_params to dict, return the mapping as JSON, and close.
observation_selectors: websocket.query_params; client.receive_json.params

stimulus_summary: Accept the supplied connect event, receive the input binary frame, send the source-selected binary response, and close.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; ordered ASGI callback tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Accept the supplied connect event, receive the input JSON text frame, send the source-selected JSON response as text, and close.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; ordered ASGI callback tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Accept the supplied connect event, receive the input text frame, send the source-selected text response, and close.
observation_selectors: action_results[*].value; ordered ASGI callback tape; client_state; application_state

stimulus_summary: Connect to /123?a=abc; have the ASGI app construct WebSocket from its live scope, send str(websocket.url) and URL components as JSON, then close.
observation_selectors: app websocket.url; emitted websocket.send JSON; client receive_json value
